main.description: A Bardcast campaign: the lore container a DM runs a party through. Chapters and prompts reference it.

dm.description: DID of the Dungeon Master who runs this campaign.

premise.description: The campaign's underlying lore and setting — the narrative engine writes from this plus character state.

party.description: AT-URIs of the character.profile records in the party.

calendar.description: Name of the in-world calendar (e.g. 'Calendar of Harptos'). Informs how storyDate strings are written.

startingLevel.description: The level characters sit down at. A higher-level sheet is replayed down to it when its seat is created. Absent means 1.

characterGuidance.description: The DM's note to players building or choosing a character for this table.

gearPolicy.description: What characters carry in. starting (the default): the table's starting kit, and their own equipment stays home. bring: their own equipment.
